h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nellore

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Nellore

c: Nellore on the Penna river is a rice and aquaculture centre on the Andhra coast, and its summers are hot, humid and long. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Nellore for the municipal corporation's parks, schools, colleges, hospitals and residential layouts. We build every machine at our factory in Vasai, about 930 km away, and send it to coastal Andhra by road.

Once the trucks arrive, our installers or a south India dealer fix each machine in place. The Nellore coast gets most of its rain from the northeast monsoon between October and December, sometimes with cyclones. Sea air and humidity are hard on bare steel, so every frame we make is galvanised. Grouting the machines into concrete footings holds them firm in strong wind and helps the base drain after heavy rain.

richText.heading: What to check after a cyclone season

c: Coastal gyms need a short inspection every year once the northeast monsoon ends. Walk round each machine and check that it stands straight, the bolts are tight and the moving parts turn freely. Clear sand, silt and leaves from the footings. If anything looks bent or loose, keep the machine out of use and call our after-sales team.

items.q: How do we protect outdoor gym equipment from Nellore's sea air?
items.a: Galvanised frames resist corrosion. Rinse the machines with fresh water every few weeks if the site is close to the coast, and tighten any loose bolts during routine checks.

items.q: What should we do if a machine is damaged in a storm?
items.a: Stop anyone using it, take photos and contact our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com. They will advise on repair or a replacement part.

items.q: Do you install outdoor gyms across the Nellore district?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai and install through our team or a dealer in south India, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground.
